origin: grade-level center of the primary building footprint

nodeGroups.S-: Primary concrete structure and floor levels
nodeGroups.A-: Architectural form, cladding, terraces, and roof elements
nodeGroups.G-: Glazing, window frames, and glass guards

viewerInteractions.explode: Moves the named floor and roof groups along Y; reset restores original GLB transforms
viewerInteractions.selection: Raycast selection reports the stable component node name in the accessible status panel

limitations: Massing dimensions are estimated from non-dimensioned supplied raster drawings and photographs.
This visual study does not validate hidden assemblies, structure, code compliance, or as-built conditions.
Exploded offsets are diagrammatic and do not represent installation or separation distances.
